► Welcome to the Backrooms! Join the amazing journey through a seperate reality as you uncover the secrets of the Backrooms.
- Inspired by The Backrooms Wiki, K. Pixels, Apeirophobia and Liminal Spaces across the whole world.

► ASYNC or the MEG, you decide, do you feel like joining the Async Research Institute and conduct research on the backrooms, or do you join the Major Explorer Group and work together with other people to uncover the secrets of the Backrooms?

► Exploration, Crafting, Interactions with other players, looting and trading is part of the game so make sure to be aware of that!

► This game was created within a year of work, so please know that we cannot see all bugs present, and therefore if you happen to encounter one, please report it to us. Thank you.
